full_judgment: There is no dispute that the property in dispute was recorded in the names of the writ petitioner's predecessors' and after purchase, it mutated its name in the record of rights, paid rent to the Government, allotted plots to its members and some of the allotees had constructed residential houses with prior approval of RAJUK. Subsequently at the instance of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka, Miscellaneous Case No. 2103 of 1995 was started as per Rule 42(Ka) of the Tenancy Rules 1959 on the plea that Plot Nos. 1685,20707 of Khatian No. 1560 was recorded in the name of some individuals. The Revenue Officer, thereupon, after service of notice directed for recording 48.26 acres of land of RS Plot Nos. 4233, 4234, 4235 and 4236 along with 29 other plots as abandoned property in the name of the Government.
